name: laneflow-monorepo
description: Root scripts for the LaneFlow monorepo. Not published. Each package under impl/ and impl-render/ is published independently.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix impl install && npm --prefix impl run build && npm --prefix impl-render install && npm --prefix impl-render run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix impl run build && npm --prefix impl-render run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix impl test && npm --prefix impl-render test
